config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK SOF-VD-10: SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition — Terminology Bindings; Constraints: sql-name/sql-expressions; Cardinality and required fields. Test these items: sql-name regex for ViewDefinition.name, constant.name, and column.name; sql-expressions constraint: at most one of forEach, forEachOrNull, or repeat; required field validation for resource, select, column.path, column.name, constant.name, constant.value[x], and where.path; resource binding validation against FHIR ResourceType; fhirVersion binding validation against FHIRVersion; expectError official fixtures fail explicitly rather than being skipped; permissive versus strict validation modes are clearly separated. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.
